expectedIssues: Middle card in the carousel is not aligned with the other cards
reportedIssues: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the content. The second card in the “Popular right now” section is partially hidden behind the bottom tab bar, making the image/card feel cut off.

The restaurant name on the right side of the “Fastest near you” row is truncated by the screen edge, showing only “Trattoria Picco…”.

expected.reasoning: No reported issue specifically describes a middle card in a carousel being misaligned; reported issues describe clipping/overlap at edges and truncation, not alignment problems of a center card.
